# Persons {#sec-persons}

Persons are items of type *person* (Q2). They are creators (P6) of works or authors (P40) of the catalogue, and can be linked to Wikidata (P24) and the Gemeinsame Normdatei (GND, P25).

```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "src"))

from baldessari import cps, table
persons = cps.persons()
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-persons
#| tbl-cap: "Persons in the CPS Wikibase with their identifiers."
shown = persons[["qid", "label", "works", "wikidata", "gnd"]]
shown.columns = ["ID", "Name", "Works created", "Wikidata", "GND"]
table(shown)
```
